name: Moong Dal Pesarattu with Ginger & Mint Chutney
ingredients: Whole green moong dal, fresh ginger, green chillies, cumin seeds, onions, coriander
pcos_benefits: Whole green moong has a naturally low glycemic index and provides steady plant protein to support balanced morning blood sugar.

name: Steamed Ragi & Urad Idli with Sambar
ingredients: Finger millet (ragi) flour, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, mixed vegetable toor dal sambar
pcos_benefits: Finger millet is exceptionally rich in calcium and dietary fibre. Fermentation enhances mineral bioavailability.

name: Vegetable Millet Upma (Foxtail / Korralu)
ingredients: Foxtail millet rava, carrots, green beans, peas, mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger
pcos_benefits: Slow-digesting complex millet starch prevents postprandial glucose surges, supporting metabolic stability in insulin resistance.

name: Korralu (Foxtail Millet) with Palak Dal & Curd
serving_size: 1 cup cooked korralu + 1 cup dal + 0.5 cup curd
ingredients: Foxtail millet grains, spinach (palak), toor dal, garlic, cumin, fresh homemade curd
pcos_benefits: Spinach provides bioavailable magnesium and folate. The pairing with pulses and fermented curd supports gut microbiome diversity.

name: Homestyle Palak Paneer with 2 Multigrain Rotis
ingredients: Spinach puree, low-fat paneer cubes, tomatoes, onions, garam masala, whole wheat and jowar flour
pcos_benefits: Supplies quality dairy protein and dietary calcium. Low glycemic impact helps prevent post-lunch fatigue.

name: South Indian Chepala Pulusu (Fish Curry) with Brown Rice
serving_size: 2 fish pieces in gravy + 1 cup brown rice
ingredients: Rohu/Murrel fish, tamarind extract, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, brown basmati rice
pcos_benefits: Fish provides anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids that help modulate systemic inflammation associated with PCOS.

name: Boiled Egg Podi Curry with 2 Jowar Rotis & Cucumber
serving_size: 2 boiled eggs in curry leaves podi + 2 rotis + cucumber slices
ingredients: Eggs, curry leaves and roasted chana podi, jowar (sorghum) flour, cucumber
pcos_benefits: Choline in whole eggs supports liver hepatic function and lipid clearance. High-protein evening meal promotes overnight glucose balance.

name: Mixed Sprouted Dal Khichdi with Roasted Flaxseed Raita
ingredients: Sprouted moong, brown rice, split pigeon peas, turmeric, cumin, curd, ground flaxseeds
pcos_benefits: Ground flaxseeds contribute alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) and lignans, supporting general hormone equilibrium.

name: Sprouted Methi & Kala Chana Chaat
ingredients: Boiled black chana, sprouted fenugreek (methi) seeds, diced cucumber, tomatoes, lemon juice, chaat masala
pcos_benefits: Fenugreek seeds contain 4-hydroxyisoleucine and soluble fibre which promote glucose tolerance and satiety.

name: Roasted Makhana & Walnuts with Green Tea
ingredients: Foxnuts (makhana), raw walnuts, pink salt, black pepper, roasted in 0.5 tsp pure ghee
pcos_benefits: Low sodium and anti-inflammatory polyunsaturated fatty acids provide clean micronutrient nourishment between main meals.
